VEC Compiler Simulator

VEC Compiler Simulator

Runs your AI self-aware invalidating compiler framework in the browser: the real trained 300-tree XGBoost model, the Validity Envelope Certificate, the exact specialization pass, the runtime guard, drift monitors, admission gate, risk firewall and atomic swap.

Market features

Order and position

Features are the three inputs the model was trained on (BTCUSDT, 1-second buckets, 300 s rolling window). Position and order size are checked by the protected risk code.

Runtime guard (VEC envelope check)

Prediction

SELL at or below 0.45HOLDBUY at or above 0.55

Decision

Follow one tree

The baseline path shows every comparison. Comparisons the compiler removed for this regime are marked, and the specialized path skips them.

The pass walks all 300 trees (16,851 split nodes) once per regime. A split is removed only if the certified feature interval proves it is always true or always false, so the output cannot differ from the baseline inside the envelope.

Results reported in your project report (C benchmark on real market data)

 
Left column is quoted from the report. Right column is whatever this page last measured, so both can be compared. The browser runs JavaScript, not your compiled C, and the synthetic stream is not your market data, so absolute times and coverage will differ. The VEC counts and exactness do not depend on either.
